attempts.summary: Deployed a Python-based inventory application on node1 as a systemd service (inventory.service) listening on 0.0.0.0:8181, serving JSON inventory data at /inventory and a /healthz endpoint. The service runs under the unconfined_service_t SELinux domain and binds successfully to port 8181 while SELinux remains in Enforcing mode (getenforce=Enforcing throughout, zero AVC denials). Verified reachability via $NODE_IP:8181 both before and after a full node restart. Performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued systemctl reboot with async acknowledgement, polled until reconnection, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified post-restart recovery of the service, port, SELinux enforcing state, and correct inventory data.
